data.question: How can I set up my device when I turn it on for the first time?(same as android 10)
data.answer:
The first time you turn on the device, you will see a welcome screen. You can start to set up your device by following the instructions.
A series of screens will lead you through the set-up process. You also have the option to skip some steps during the process.

data.question: How can I change the language of the device? (same as android 10)
data.answer:
The first time in setup wizard interface to scroll the pop-up menu to choose a language as your device language.
Or you can change the language by accessing the main menu -> “Settings” -> “System”-> “Languages & input” -> “Languages” -> “Add a language” -> Choose the language that you want to add -> Press and drag the language to the top to select it.

data.question: How can I check the IMEI number of my device?
data.answer:
You have 3 ways to check the IMEI information:
Method 1: Check the IMEI information from the IMEI label which is stuck to the device body.
Method 2: Enter *#06# in the dialing keypad.
Note: If a SIM card is not inserted in your phone, the IMEI information may not appear on the screen. Please insert a SIM card and then check the IMEI information again by typing *#06#.
Method 3: Go to the main menu -> “Settings” -> “System” -> “About phone” -> “Status” -> “IMEI (SIM slot 1/2)”.

data.question: How can I check the device’s model number, Android version, CPU information, RAM & Storage information, battery capacity? (same as android 10)
data.answer: You can check this information by accessing it from the main menu -> “Settings” -> “System”-> “About phone”.

data.question: How can I take a screenshot?
data.answer:
You can easily share what's on your screens by taking screenshots. Hardware buttons let you snap a screenshot and store it locally. Afterwards, you can view, edit, and share the screen shot in Gallery or a similar app.
Method 1: Push the power button and Volume down button at the same time for a couple of seconds.
Method 2: Swipe down to access the quick settings from any screen, and then click the screenshot icon to take a screenshot.
You should then see an animation showing you the screenshot, and view the screenshot by tapping on the thumbnail in the notification tray or by visiting your Gallery application.

data.question: How can I change the permissions for my apps?
data.answer: You can change the “app permission” in “Settings” -> “Apps” -> “Permissions manager” -> selecting a topic. Check the choice-box to allow or deny individual permissions.

data.question: What is the Autofill function? (new) (same as android 10)
data.answer:
Go to “Settings” -> “System” -> “Languages & input” -> “Advanced” ->“Autofill service”.
Having your phone automatically type out your information is pretty useful, and Google’s giving Android system the ability to make it work with a wider variety of methods that apps and sites could use to prompt you for your password, and will recognize when you enter the last digits of your credit card number and save them too.

data.question: What is Google Lens?
data.answer:
Google Lens can automatically recognize and search within the content which appears in the lens. There’re several ways to use the Google Lens function.
Note that Google Lens works only when you login with Google account and your device must be connected to a network.
Method 1: touch the “Camera” app -> touch the Google Lens icon .
Method 2: press and hold the home button or press Google Assistant Button to enter Google assistant -> touch the Google Lens icon at the bottom of the screen.
Method 3: touch the “Photos” app -> select a photo -> touch the Google Lens icon  at the bottom of the screen.
On Android 11, Google Lens has seven features:
1) Translate: Point at text, then tap capture to translate.
2) Text: Take a photo of words to copy.
3) Search: Tap shutter button to search.
4) Homework: Point at homework, then tap capture for help.
5) Shopping: Take a photo of products or barcodes.
6) Places: Point at buildings for details.
7) Dining: Take a photo of food or a menu.

data.question: How can I activate the accessibility menu?
data.answer:
The Accessibility Menu provides a large on-screen menu to control your phone. You can control gestures, hardware buttons, navigation, and so on.
1) To use this feature, system navigation buttons should be enabled: go to “Settings”->”Button & gestures”->”System navigation”->”Buttons”.
2) Then go to “Settings” -> “Accessibility” -> “Accessibility Menu” ->touch the toggle to “On” position->touch “ALLOW” -> the accessibility menu icon will appear on the navigation bar.

data.question: How can I manage app notification quick and easy?(new)
data.answer:
When you touch and hold a notification on status bar, there will be two options appear “Prioritised” and “Silent”.
1)    Select “Prioritised” to allow sound alert for this app at subsequent new notifications.
2)    Select “Silent” to mute all notifications from this app
You can go to “Settings”->”Apps”-> “VIEW ALL APPS” -> select the app you want to set->”App notifications” to further setup.

data.question: What can I do if my app show “App paused” when I touch it?(new) (same as android 10)
data.answer:
In Android 11, there is a new menu “Digital Wellbeing & parental controls”, you can customize the time limit for using the phone so that have a healthy and balanced life. Set daily timers for most apps, when the app timer ends, the app is paused for the rest of the day.
Touch “Settings” from main menu->touch “Digital Wellbeing & parental controls”->touch “Dashboard” (touch “show your data” first if it is the first time to access this setting)->touch the app which you want to cancel app timer-> touch trash can icon to delete timer.

data.question: What can I do if my phone screen become black item?(new)
data.answer:
Your screen will become black in dark mode, which makes it easier to look at your screen or read in dim light.
1)    Go to “Settings”->”Display”->touch “Dark mode”->touch the trigger to activate /deactivate it.
2)    Drag down quick settings bar in any interface ->touch "Dark mode icon" to activate/deactivate it (slide to the left to view it in the second page).

data.question: What can I do if my phone screen is yellowing?
data.answer:
a.    Check whether “Eye comfort mode” is active. Eye comfort mode will filter out blue light and adjust the colour temperature of your display to reduce eye strain.
1) Go to “Settings”->”Display”-> “Eye comfort mode”->touch the trigger to activate /deactivate it.
2) Drag down quick settings bar in any interface ->touch "Eye comfort mode” icon to activate/deactivate it.
b.    In reading mode, the screen will become monochromic to imitate physical books. Go to “Settings”->”NXTVISION”->”Reading mode”, touch the trigger to activate/deactivate it.

data.question: How can I active gesture navigation (hide the navigation bar)?(new) (same as android 10)
data.answer:
Android has always featured navigation buttons, including a back button — but they’re now going away with Android 11 in favor of a new gesture-based navigation system.
There’s no gesture indicator on the screen under new gesture navigation mode, but you can switch back to the three-button navigation system of old if you want to.
Just go to “Settings” -> “Button & gestures” -> “System Navigation” to choose the right option for you.

data.question: When I quickly touch on display three times the smartphone makes a zoom on display. How can I stop this feature? (New)
data.answer: Please go to “Settings”->”Accessibility”->”Magnification”, disable “Magnification shortcut”

data.question: How can I change font size on display?
data.answer: Please go to “Settings”->”Display”->”Font size”.

data.question: How can I silence the ringtone of an incoming call?
data.answer:
There’re several ways to silence the ringer before answering a call.
Method 1: Press the Volume Down or Power button on the side of your device.
Method 2: Go to menu -> “Settings” -> “Sound & vibration”-> activate “Silent mode”.
Method 3: Drag the Status Bar down with your finger and then touch the “Sound” icon to change to “Vibrate”.
Note: Press the “power” key and “volume up” key at the same time to switch to vibration mode quickly.

data.question: How can I activate three way calling?
data.answer:
You can activate three way calling as follows:
1)    Call the first person.
2)    Touch “Add call”   (this function may under menu according to the different phones), then you can choose the third person you want to call.
3)    When you get through to the second or the third person (depending on how many calls you want to merge), you can touch “Merge calls”   to make a conference call.
* Three way calling requires network/SIM card support, please contact your SIM
operator to make sure you have the three way calling service.

data.question: What should I do if I cannot receive calls or miss calls constantly?
data.answer:
1) If this issue only occurs in certain places, move to a location with a strong signal and try again.
2) Check whether there are smudges or scratches on your SIM card's metal surface as a defective SIM card may affect signal stability. If necessary, contact your operator to obtain a replacement SIM.
3) Check whether “Blocked numbers” or “Filter spam calls” is active on your phone: touch “Phone” app-> touch settings icon   at the top right corner->”Settings”->check “Blocked numbers” & “Call ID & spam”.
4) Please try to recovery with turn on and off Airplane mode or reboot the device;
5) Please contact your service provider to check if any re-activate process needed for your service account.

data.question: How can I use a SIM card to do video calls? (new)
data.answer:
To use SIM card video call, you should check the requirements below:
1)    Video call requires network/SIM card support, please contact your SIM operator to make sure you have the video call service.
2)    Make sure called party also support video call and his/her SIM operator is the same as yours Video call option will appear during voice call is connecting when above requirements are met.

data.question: How to import your contacts directly into your Google Account? (same as android 10)
data.answer:
1)    Install the SIM card with your contacts on it in your new phone.
2)    Touch “Contacts” app.
3)    Touch the settings icon   at the top left corner of the screen.
4)    Touch “Settings”.
5)    Touch “Import”.
6)    Choose a place where you want to copy your contacts from, take phone for example and touch “OK”.
7)    Choose the contacts you want to copy and touch the   icon in the top right corner of the screen.

data.question: How can I change the default ringtone and adjust the volume for incoming calls?
data.answer:
Your phone uses sounds and vibrations to notify you of some events, using ringtones, notifications, alarms and navigation feedback. You can customize any of these sounds, as well as control their volumes.
a.    Change default ringtone for incoming calls.
1)    Touch the “Settings” icon from the Home screen or under the main menu.
2)    Touch “Sound & vibration”.
3)    Touch “Phone ringtone & vibrate”
4)    You will see a list of ringtones.
5)    Touch a ringtone to select and hear it. Or you can touch “Add ringtone”, choose an MP3 you like from music app and touch “OK”.
6)    Touch “OK” to confirm your final selection.
b.    Adjust volume for incoming calls.
1)    Touch the “Settings” icon from the Home screen or under the main menu.
2)    Touch “Sound & vibration”.
3)    You will see a Volume Bar. Drag to adjust the volume.

data.question: How can I use split screen?
data.answer:
The split screen behavior of the current project is as follows:
1)    Click the Menu key to enter the interface of the app recently used.
2)    Drag and drop the small icon in the upper left corner to enter split screen mode.
Note: By the way, drag the icon to the upper right corner to enter hover mode.

data.question: How does my phone connect to a Wi-Fi network? (new) (same as android 10)
data.answer:
There have been some under-the-hood changes to Wi-Fi in Android 11, which make it faster and more secure to connect to other devices
Method1: Turn on Wi-Fi by following these steps:
1)    Touch the “Settings” icon from the Home screen or under the main menu.
2)    Touch Wi-Fi.
3)    Turn the switch to “On” position, the device will scan for available networks and display their names.
*Secured networks are indicated with a lock icon.
*If the device finds a network that you connected to previously, it connects to it.
4)    Touch a network name to see more details or connect to it.
5)    Enter a password or other credentials to connect to the network.
Method 2:
It’s now also easier to give your Wi-Fi password to someone else via the Settings menu. Under the Wi-Fi section, you can share the password in the form of a QR code, or read one such QR code to connect to Wi-Fi. No more turning your router this way and that to find the sticker with the password on it.
1)    Please refer to Method 1 step1 to step 3
2)    Touch a network name
3)    Touch  icon beside password input line.
4)    Scan the QR code to connect the Wi-Fi network.

data.question: Why can’t I connect to a specific Wi-Fi router? (New)
data.answer:
The Android 11 includes security tools that limit apps’ access to device IMEI, serial number, and other identifying information. It will also give you a little more protection when using Wi-Fi networks by randomizing your device’s MAC (media access control) address.
If you use your device for business, your organization might require Wi-Fi mac address of your device for wireless connection. In Android 11, privacy setting of Wi-Fi use randomized MAC by default, you need to change it to “Use device MAC” manually, follow steps below to change:
1)    Touch “Settings”
2)    Touch “Wi-Fi”
3)    Touch and hold the Wi-Fi name with connected status in the list
4)    Touch “Modify network” in the dialog that opens
5)    Touch “Advanced options”
6)    Touch “Use randomized MAC” under privacy, then touch “Use device MAC” in the pop-up menu.

data.question: How many bluetooth devices are supported at the same time?
data.answer:
In Android 11, you can pair with four bluetooth devices at the same time and seamlessly switch between them. If there is an incoming call, it will automatically switch to any bluetooth speaker or other audio accessory that can handle the call.
The system will remember the volume of each bluetooth device automatically.

data.question: How can I active Live Caption on my device?
data.answer:
Android 11 will bring native support for captions, which can show up in real-time over videos that might not have support for captions. For example, if you are scrolling through Instagram and suddenly a video starts auto-playing, Android will show you captions on the screen.
What’s more, Live Caption will work even if you’ve put your device in Airplane Mode, or if you don’t have internet access.
Go to “Settings”->”Accessibility”->”Captions”, touch toggle to active captions function

data.question: How can I back up my data on the device?
data.answer:
You can back up your data to google drive using the following steps.
1)    Go “Settings”.
2)    Touch “System”
3)    Touch “Backup”.
4)    Activate “Back up to Google Drive” in the open window.
5)    Touch “Back up Now”
* App data, SMS text messages, Device settings, Call history, Contacts will be backed up.
For more back up & sync help, please continue touch “Google Photos”->”Back up & sync help”.

data.question: How can I perform a factory reset on my phone?
data.answer:
You can use the following steps to reset your phone in the boot status.
1)    Go to “Settings”.
2)    Touch “System”
3)    Touch “Reset”.
4)    Touch “Factory data reset” to start.
5)    Touch “RESET PHONE” in the open window.
6)    Touch “RESET PHONE” in the open window Second time.
Warning: this action will erase all your personal information and downloaded apps.
The function of long pressing the power button + volume button to enter the Recovery
Mode is not enabled in the current project.

data.question: How can I set up my SD card?
data.answer: Go to “Settings” ->  “Storage” -> touch Portable storage “SD card”, then you can browse the contents of SD card, such as downloads, music, pictures, etc.

data.question: How can I transfer data from the internal storage to the SD card?
data.answer: Touch “File Manager” -> touch “Internal storage” -> touch and hold to select which data such as downloads, files, pictures, etc. you want to move -> touch the   icon at the top right corner on the screen -> touch “Move” -> touch the SD card icon -> select a files and touch Move icon at the bottom right of the corner on the screen.

data.question: How can I format SD card in my device?
data.answer: Go to “Settings” -> “Storage” -> “SD card” -> touch the   icon at the top right corner-> “Storage settings” -> “Format”->”FORMAT SD CARD”.

data.question: What can I do if my phone asks me to enter Google account data after a factory reset has been made? (same as android 10)
data.answer:
You may need to enter the original Google account that was used on this phone after you execute a factory data reset, otherwise you will not be able to use the phone. This is the FRP (Factory Reset Protection) function.
If you don’t remember your Google account data, please complete the Google account recovery procedure. In case you can’t recover it, please apply to a repair center.

data.question: Why does my face unlock function work slowly or fail? (same as android 10)
data.answer:
1)    In conditions when bright sunlight is behind you, the speed of unlocking can be slow or maybe fail.
2)    When the ambient light is dark, the speed of unlocking can be slow or maybe fail.
3)    When you are wearing sunglasses or something which covers your face, it can also fail to unlock.

data.question: How can I turn on USB debugging? (same as android 10)
data.answer:
To turn on the USB debugging, you can use the following steps.
1)    Go to “Settings” -> “System”-> “About phone” -> “Build number”.
2)    Touch the Build number no less than 7 times.
3)    You will see a pop-windows “Allow development setting?”, click “ok”.
4)    Go back to “System” again, you will now find the “Developer options”.
5)    Activate “Developer options”.
6)    Activate “USB debugging”.

data.question: What should I do when I insert or remove a SIM card?
data.answer: This phone support SIM card hot swap, you can insert or remove your SIM card while your device is power on.

data.question: What should I do if my device cannot charge or charges slowly? (same as android 10)
data.answer:
1)  Check if the device has any battery drain issues. When the device consumes battery too fast, it results in slow charging.
2)  Verify whether there are any third-party power management software apps downloaded. If so, please uninstall these.
3)  Only use the official charger to charge your device.
4)  Please don't use the device for a long time while it is charging.
5)  Please back up your personal data, then reset or update your device to the latest system version and try again.
If the problem persists, back up your data and take your device and proof of purchase to one of our repair centers to get more professional technical assistance.

data.question: How can I connect my phone to a PC via a USB cable? (same as android 10)
data.answer:
When your device connects to a PC, the device will ask you which mode you want to use.
To transfer data between the device and computer, select “Transfer files” mode.
To transfer photos or files if MTP is not supported (PTP), select “Transfer photos (PTP)”.
To disable all data and file transfer connections with the computer and put device in charging only mode, select “Charge this device”.
Computers that use Windows XP might not connect properly, because they don’t have the proper drivers installed by default. To fix this, download and install Windows Media Player 11 or higher which contains the proper drivers.
Computers that use Mac OS X 10.5 or later might not connect properly, because they don’t have the proper drivers installed by default. To fix this, download and install Android File Transfer which contains the proper drivers.

data.question: What kinds of phone use may potentially damage the battery?
data.answer:
1)    Using a non-standard charger instead of the official charger.
2)    Using damaged cables or chargers, or charging when moisture is present, which can cause fire, electric shock, injury, or damage your phone or other property.
3)    Exposing your phone or battery to heat sources.
4)    We recommend that you do not use the phone for long periods of time while it is charging, as it will harm your battery.
**When you use the official charger to charge your phone, make sure the USB cable is inserted into the power adapter fully before you plug the adapter into a power outlet.

data.question: How can I use the Talkback feature?
data.answer:
Talkback is a screen reader primarily for people with blindness and low vision. It allows interaction with the device using spoken feedback. In this mode, you need to quickly touch the button twice to choose the button.
Please go to “Settings”->”Accessibility”->”Talkback”, touch the toggle to turn on/off it.
To navigate using Talkback:
-Swipe right or left to move between items
-Double –tap to activate an item
-Drag two finger to scroll
